original_method: Freeze the endpoint/root-port/lane topology, firmware, link target, NVQual/LTSSM build, and EOM limits; capture baseline; run exactly fifty approved iterations; preserve lane-level margins and iteration status with synchronized LTSSM, negotiated-link, AER, kernel, and management evidence; stop on the first disqualifying anomaly and verify recovery.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE supplies the proprietary qualification environment and limits; an operator validates topology, service isolation, console recovery, and supervises the long repeated-training run.

review_improvement: Preserves the fifty-loop vendor qualification while making lane/path identity, iteration completeness, margin acceptance, link-error correlation, and safe termination auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: EOM qualification measures analog margin, whereas negotiated speed and absence of a final kernel error are only indirect health indicators. A path can retrain successfully while one lane falls below the vendor eye threshold, and a later clean state can hide an earlier corrected error or downtrain. Therefore every numbered iteration needs its own lane-resolved result and correlated digital-link state. The fifty-loop requirement is a repetition coverage claim, so aborted, missing, or rerun iterations cannot be silently replaced after a failure; their chronology determines the engineering verdict.
